- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Scylla is a six-headed sea monster that devoured sailors and was transformed from a beautiful nymph by Poseidon.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Charybdis is a giant whirlpool that could swallow ships and was cursed by Zeus after stealing his lightning bolts.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Kraken is a giant sea creature with tentacles that drags ships beneath the waves and emerges during storms.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Sirens are creatures with the upper body of a woman and the tail of a fish, luring sailors to their deaths with their songs; Odysseus resisted them by tying himself to his ship's mast.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Triton is a merman, son of Poseidon, who controls the waves and sea creatures.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Nereids are sea nymphs, daughters of Nereus, depicted riding dolphins and protecting sailors.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Leviathan is a massive sea serpent that breathes fire and can sink ships; it can only be defeated by a hero of great courage.
